name: Comic Ink Halftone SDXL (as downloaded - INERT)
means: Nothing, in this ComfyUI build - same key-naming fault as its sibling. Kept as provenance for comic-ink-halftone_cfy.safetensors, which also failed on its merits. Do not put either in a workflow.
verdict: MEASURED INERT. Ladder at 0 / 0.65 / 0.85 / 1.0 on animagine, trigger in every cell: four pixel-identical images, and 3360 `lora key not loaded` lines in the ComfyUI log - 1120 of 1120 keys ignored per cell. Byte-for-byte the same file size as risograph-print.safetensors (93,065,304) and the same 1120-tensor attention-only geometry, so the two share an uploader template and shared the same fault.
note: THE GATE THIS WAS BOUGHT AGAINST. studio/_tools/model_intake.py rendered eleven style probes on four installed engines before anything was downloaded (samples/model_intake/base_animagine-xl-4.jpg, base_Illustrious-XL-v2.jpg, cross_flux2.jpg, cross_qwen.jpg). Ten of the eleven were already covered: animagine renders pixel art, coloring-book lineart and a genuine watercolour from tags; Illustrious renders real painterly oil that animagine cannot; FLUX.2 renders claymation, woodcut, comic halftone, low-poly PS1, watercolour and photography outright; Qwen renders photography and nothing else - every probe came back a photograph, exactly as the project's standing rule says. Same root cause and same fix as risograph-print - see that card for the comfy/lora.py line references. example_note: Left cell is the control at strength 0 and the trigger phrase is in that cell too, so strength is the only variable. A LoRA is a delta on the base weights - a single with-the-LoRA image proves nothing, the OFF cell is the evidence.
